question: Which dates are directly visible on the 1963 A-628 diplomatic airgram, separately from its date of drafting, claimed 1964 event date, and the FBIS 8 Nov 1963 report?

source.independence: Same diplomatic airgram as C05/C06/C09/C10/C16: not a new independent witness to the alleged event

records.page_location: p1, right of FROM and above SUBJECT
p1, top right above handling-indicator area
p1, bottom near 'FOR DEPT USE ONLY'

records.text_seen: Reportedly Sighted Near Salvador, Bahia on November 8, 1964.
records.page_location: p1 SUBJECT; directly conflicts with document dated 1963

interpretation.confirmed: The photographed page has the typed date 20-Nov-1963, visible 24-Nov-1963 and 26-Nov-1963 date marks, and an inconsistent 8-Nov-1964 SUBJECT.
interpretation.not_confirmed: Who stamped it, whether a stamp is a receipt/distribution/archive action, exact time of arrival in Washington, original press clippings, physical UFO/balloon/radar observation.
interpretation.hypothesis_h1: The 24/26-Nov marks are later administrative processing stamps on the 1963 airgram; compatible with page but functions not yet proved.
interpretation.hypothesis_h2: The subject year 1964 describes a distinct 1964 incident; contradicted by the airgram's 1963 date and references to 14-Nov-1963 telegrams and 9/11-Nov-1963 newspapers.

candidate_lean_restriction.expression: if verified_as_dispatch_or_receipt_stamp(mark) then corresponding chronological relation holds

interpretation.priority_next_test: Find the original Airgram handling/copy control conventions (DS-323, 1963) or original archival cover sheet with arrival timestamp; do not infer arrival time from the marks alone.

negative_searches.queries: NORAD 528 1963-003B 7-9 Nov SPADATS Space Intelligence Bulletins (targeted web searches, 12 Nov 2026)
negative_searches.result: No primary sensor report naming object 528 recovered; mostly modern catalog derivatives and original messages about 687/688. Do not infer no such report exists.

negative_searches.queries: Diário de Notícias 9 Nov 1963 and Jornal da Bahia 11 Nov 1963 original page indexes
negative_searches.result: Only modern 2026 retellings and references to A-628 encountered, not actual newspaper facsimiles.

negative_searches.queries: NASA SSR volume 3 issue 21 circa 30-31 Oct 1963 NTRS
negative_searches.result: Specific facsimile not identified; issues 22 and 23 readily indexed.
